const input = $json;
const compact = JSON.stringify(input);
const prompt = `You are the local scheduling planner for AI-ASFA. Return ONLY JSON.

Required output shape:
{"status":"resolved|alternative|failed","explanation":"short explanation","timetable":[...]}

Rules:
- Never invent subject IDs or faculty IDs.
- Keep subject_id, faculty_id, co_faculty_id and component from the supplied database context.
- Theory has Main faculty only. Co faculty is only valid for Lab.
- Main and Co faculty cannot be the same.
- A faculty member cannot teach two sessions at the same time.
- Normal theory classes cannot overlap in the same semester slot.
- Labs may overlap only when their faculty sets do not overlap.
- Keep lab blocks contiguous and respect lab duration, breaks and lunch.
- Respect working days and periods per day.
- Respect cycle P/C when supplied.
- Do not change faculty assignments to solve a conflict; move timetable sessions instead.
- If conflicts are present, fix them. If there are no conflicts, generate ONE different valid alternative.
- Return every timetable row needed, not only changed rows.

Input:
${compact}`;
return [{ json: { model: input.model || 'qwen3:4b', prompt, stream: false } }];
